title: PushPress vs Gymdesk: Pricing, Fees & Features (2026)
description: PushPress vs Gymdesk for martial arts schools: $0 Free plan at 4.99% vs from $75/mo, when Pro pays off, belt tracking, websites and branded apps.
body:
PushPress and Gymdesk are two of the most common picks for martial arts schools and BJJ gyms, and they charge in opposite ways. PushPress has a $0/mo Free plan and makes its money on card processing (4.99% + $0.30 per card payment on Free), with flat-priced Pro ($159/mo) and Max ($229/mo) plans that lower the rate. Gymdesk has no free plan. It charges by active members, starting at $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments, and every feature comes with every tier.

We checked both vendors' own pricing and feature pages on November 16, 2026. We haven't used either product ourselves and we don't publish ratings. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

PushPress plans include unlimited members, staff and admins, so the plan price doesn't change with headcount. Gymdesk doesn't count visitors, frozen or cancelled members, or prospects as active members. Sources: pushpress.com/pricing and gymdesk.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-16.

Time-limited offer: PushPress lists a Black Friday deal of 30% off any PushPress product for the first 6 months (Pro $111.30/mo, Max $160.30/mo, then full price) for sign-ups by December 11, 2026. It can't be combined with other promotions. Gymdesk listed no discount on its pricing page when we checked.

What processing fees do to the PushPress price

Because PushPress Free has no monthly fee but a higher rate, the real cost depends on how much you bill by card. Using PushPress's published rates, a school that bills $8,000 a month by card in 80 payments of $100 would pay about:

  • Free: $0 + $399.20 (4.99%) + $24 (80 × $0.30) = $423.20/mo
  • Pro: $159 + $231.20 (2.89%) + $24 = $414.20/mo
  • Max: $229 + $220.00 (2.75%) + $24 = $473.00/mo

Pro's card rate is 2.1 points lower than Free's, so Pro pays for itself at about $7,571 a month in card payments ($159 ÷ 2.1%). Below that, Free costs less. Max only beats Pro on card fees above about $50,000 a month, so most schools would pick Max for its other features, not the rate. The ACH gap is the same 2.1 points (2.89% vs 0.79%), so steering families to bank payments lowers the Free-plan cost too.

For Gymdesk we can only compare the software fee, because Gymdesk doesn't publish the Gymdesk Payments rate. At 80 active members Gymdesk is $100/mo with Gymdesk Payments, or $125/mo plus whatever Stripe, Square or Authorize.net charges you. Ask Gymdesk for the rate in writing before you compare totals. Our martial arts billing software guide compares processing fees across more tools, and the membership revenue calculator helps estimate your monthly card volume.

Two things to confirm before you sign

  • Gymdesk Payments coverage. Gymdesk's pricing page says Gymdesk Payments is available in the US and Canada, but its Gymdesk Payments page FAQ says "US only for now." Canadian schools should confirm before counting on the $25/mo discount (Gymdesk says integrated processing through an approved partner qualifies for the same rate, subject to approval).
  • Gymdesk and Smoothcomp. Gymdesk's site now says "Gymdesk and Smoothcomp are now one company" and lists tournament registration and competition records. That may matter if your BJJ team competes; ask what's included in your plan.

Switching and your data

Gymdesk says you can export members, attendance history, payment records, waivers and documents yourself at any time, with no exit fee. It also says saved card tokens can usually move between Stripe, Square or Authorize.net and Gymdesk Payments without members re-entering cards. PushPress lists a 3-step migration tool for importing member data from another system. If you're moving schools between platforms, read the token-transfer terms of your current processor first.

Which to pick

PushPress Free fits a small school that bills under about $7,500 a month by card and doesn't need belt tracking in the software. Once you want Rank Tracking you're on Pro at $159/mo. Gymdesk fits schools up to about 100 active members that want belt tracking, a website and marketing tools in one price ($75-$100/mo with Gymdesk Payments), as long as you're comfortable with an unpublished processing rate. Above 150 members, Gymdesk ($200-$240/mo) costs more than PushPress Pro's flat $159, but PushPress charges extra for the website and marketing (Grow, $329/mo). You can try Gymdesk free for 30 days, and PushPress Free costs nothing to start, so you can test both with your real schedule. {{aff:pushpress|Visit PushPress}} {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}}

faq: Not always. PushPress Free is $0/mo but charges 4.99% + $0.30 per card payment; Pro is $159/mo with 2.89% + $0.30. Gymdesk is $75-$200/mo with Gymdesk Payments depending on active members (up to 250), but doesn't publish its processing rate (pushpress.com/pricing, gymdesk.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-16).
When does PushPress Pro cost less than PushPress Free?
Pro's card rate is 2.1 percentage points lower than Free's, so the $159/mo fee is covered at about $7,571 a month in card payments. Below that, Free costs less in total.
Does PushPress Free include belt tracking?
No. PushPress lists Rank Tracking on the Pro and Max plans only. Gymdesk includes rank progression on every tier.
Gymdesk includes a responsive gym website on every plan. PushPress lists websites as part of PushPress Grow, a $329/mo add-on.
How much is the branded app?
PushPress's Branded App is $97/mo. Gymdesk's branded member app is $100/mo with the first month free. Both are add-ons.

Gymdesk is month to month with no setup or cancellation fee and a 30-day trial with no credit card. PushPress doesn't publish contract terms on its pricing page; its Free plan has no monthly fee and no trial that runs out.
